rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for personally experiencing or going through an event or phase.

example.english: I had to undergo a very difficult phase in my life.
example.traditional: 我經歷過人生一段好艱難嘅時期。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ging1 lik6 gwo3 jan4 sang1 jat1 dyun6 hou2 gaan1 naan4 ge3 si4 kei4

rows.note: Use this for undergoing or passing through a process, period, or stage, while 經歷 focuses more on lived experience.

example.english: We had to undergo several months of training before we could finally compete.
example.traditional: 我哋經過幾個月嘅訓練，終於可以出賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 fan3 lin6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 coi3

rows.note: Use this when someone is subjected to an unpleasant event, injury, trauma, or consequence.

example.english: After I undergo trauma, I become very withdrawn.
example.traditional: 我受到創傷之後，成個人都好消沉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau6 dou3 cong1 soeng1 zi1 hau6 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 hou2 siu1 cam4

rows.note: Use this colloquially when the emphasis is on enduring hardship, pain, or difficulty.

example.english: I had to undergo months of pain from my illness.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaai4 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 beng6 tung3
